newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Opposition leader reshuffles ministry.
newsitem.headline: Australian Opposition leader reshuffles ministry.

text.p: Australian Opposition Leader Kim Beazley rearranged his shadow ministry on Thursday, saying he wanted to sharpen the focus on ministerial accountability.
Opposition Senate Leader John Faulkner would take on a newly invented role of spokesman for public administration and government services.
Opposition spokespeople are usually responsible for exactly the same areas as government ministers.
Faulkner's new role has no government counterpart, but Beazley said he was aiming to highlight accountabiity, an area in which Prime Minister John Howard claims high standards.

Beazley said he was reshuffling "firstly to provide us with a platform for new directions in policy reform, secondly to give emphasis to holding this government accountable ... and then to focus on regional Australia and the state outside the south-east corner of the country".
Peter Baldwin, formerly the spokesman on education, has moved to the opposition finance portfolio where he will shadow the minister, John Fahey.
Baldwin, a former social security minister, was good at cost-efficient social policy, Beazley said.
Beazley said the Labor opposition's new frontbench would be:
Small Busines, Customs, Sport Stephen Martin
